name: herdr-control
description: herdr-control tooling — agent + full verify suite on open

panes.cmd: for v in verify-*.sh test-*.sh; do echo "== $v =="; bash "$v" || { echo "FAILED: $v"; break; }; done; for v in verify-*.py; do echo "== $v =="; python3 "$v" || { echo "FAILED: $v"; break; }; done; exec $SHELL
